{{Quote|I want that guardian droid's ''control disk!"<br />"''You ''fink!'' I wouldn't give it to you even if I knew what you were ''talking'' about!|Tig Fromm and Nikki Idd|<ref name="Droids (1986) 2">[[Droids (1986) 2|''Droids'' (1986) 2]]</ref>}}
A '''control disk''' was a piece of technology that controlled [[HK Guardian Droid|guardian droids]]. At some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] and [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] dressed in the empty shell of a guardian [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in order to subdue the [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang]] while aboard [[Lonn Idd's repair station]]. Fromm fell for the ruse and demanded that [[Lonn Idd]]'s daughter, [[Nikki Idd]], hand over the droid's control disk, but she instead sprayed him in the face with [[Nova Starlight]] [[Perfume/Legends|perfume]].
